blocks.text: Your journey begins in Oaxaca, where every street reflects centuries of tradition. Upon arrival at Oaxaca International Airport, a bilingual representative will greet you for a smooth private transfer to your hotel in the historic center or nearby hotel zone. The rest of the day is at leisure—settle in, explore at your own pace, enjoy a sunset stroll, sip your first mezcal, or relax. Included: Private arrival transfer and overnight. Optional: Early check-in or evening experience (upon request).
